title: The Assistant's Status update button sweeps every session across projects and proposes cleanup

requirements.text: genlock sweep (Assistant only) prints one block per open session in every project, spin-offs and extra sessions included, with its state, idle time, the task it owns and that task's proof count

sweep prints a SUGGEST line for: a task with every requirement proved but still open, a session whose task is done, a session idle 12h+ owning no open task, an open in_progress task whose owner has no session, a session in state waiting
genlock close PROJECT SESSION writes close.json to that session's channel and exits non-zero when its state.json says working; the app ends a session with close.json and adds it to Recently ended

A Status update button in the dashboard header opens the Assistant and submits the sweep prompt; assistantRule tells it to run genlock sweep, report per project, then list proposed actions and run them only on the user's yes
requirements.check: swift build + grep assistantRule + eye: button in dashboard header
